storyline: During the war between the gods and giants, Mars was so eager to prove his skill in warfare that he engaged in a fierce battle with Otus and Ephialtes.
The young giants were very proud of having conquered the god of war, and carried him off the battle-field in triumph.
They bound Mars with iron chains, and kept a careful guard over him so that none of the gods could set him free.

When they did not come back, he sent others to look for them, and when these did not return, he went himself to see what had caused all this delay.
